say:1:1110639001:1.text: Brutus, by my honor I'm utterly ashamed of what Orson has done. Are you truly alright?
say:1:1110639001:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人，我为奥格的作为感到惭愧。您真的还好吗？

say:2:1110639002:0.text: Please let me escort you down the mountain. As a representative of the Grimmaw Clan, it's my duty to remedy his wrongdoing.
say:2:1110639002:0.source_cn: 请先让我送您下山，处理伤情。奥格的过错，我作为黑嚎氏族...

say:4:1110639003:1.text: Kruger, I appreciate your words, but I'm not leaving.
say:4:1110639003:1.source_cn: 克鲁格，我理解你的心情。但我不会走的。

say:6:1110639005:1.text: Please. Our mage friend has already treated my wounds. I assure you I'm fine.
say:6:1110639005:1.source_cn: 稍安勿躁。刚才，乌尔氏族的魔法师朋友替我处理了伤口。现...
say:6:1110639005:1.male: Please. Our mage friend has already treated my wounds. I assure you I'm fine.
say:6:1110639005:1.female: Please. Our mage friend has already treated my wounds. I assure you I'm fine.

say:7:1110639006:1.text: Thank you, friend. You've kept me in the fight.
say:7:1110639006:1.source_cn: 多谢你，朋友。托你的福，我现在已经准备好迎接下一次战斗。
say:7:1110639006:1.male: Thank you, friend. You've kept me in the fight.
say:7:1110639006:1.female: Thank you, friend. You've kept me in the fight.

say:9:1110639008:1.text: Kruger, this wasn't your doing. Blaming yourself isn't heroic; you don't have to bear any guilt in the name of the Grimmaw Clan.
say:9:1110639008:1.source_cn: 克鲁格，这不是你的错。迁怒并非英雄所为，你不必为了保护...

say:10:1110639009:1.text: Moreover, my concern is for the young Alsa and Soren. Of course, Orson also troubles me. I wonder who did this to him...
say:10:1110639009:1.source_cn: 而且，我很担心索恩和阿尔萨这两个年轻人。当然，我也像你...

say:11:1110639010:1.source_cn: 我明白了，既然话说到这个地步，我没有理由再反对。

say:12:1110639011:1.text: Let's make for the summit. There's no telling what awaits us there, but we must be prepared.
say:12:1110639011:1.source_cn: 登上峰顶吧。那里或许正在发生我们不愿看到的事……但我们...
